name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet hip-width apart and arms by your sides.
Brace your core and drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pause briefly at the top while squeezing your glutes tightly.
Lower your hips slowly back to the floor with control.
tips: Keep your rib cage down and avoid overarching your lower back at the top of the bridge.
Keep your knees tracking straight ahead rather than letting them fall inward or splay out.
